# Wickra Verify

> Hand over a (strategy, data, claimed report) triple and get a deterministic verdict — confirmed or refuted — that anyone can recompute in ten languages.

Wickra Verify takes a strategy, its data and a claimed backtest report, recomputes the backtest, and returns a deterministic verdict: confirmed or refuted, with the difference where the two disagree. Whether the report matches and whether its hash matches are reported separately, so a mis-blessed claim is visible rather than masked. Released under the MIT OR Apache-2.0 license.

## Source
- [GitHub](https://github.com/wickra-lib/wickra-verify): Source, issues, and releases.

## Ecosystem
- [Wickra](https://wickra.org): The core streaming-indicator library the ecosystem is built on.
- [Docs](https://docs.wickra.org): Documentation for the Wickra core.
